notes.title: NEW UPDATE LIVE NOW
notes.notes:
A fresh wave of story, systems, and other upgrades has arrived in Absym. This update deepens the world’s lore while making your moment-to-moment experience clearer and more immersive.

Bloodbound Court Cutscene
A brand-new cutscene introduces a new event at the beginning of the demo, setting the stage for what’s to come.

Systems & Tracking
Item Tracking Implemented

You can now easily keep tabs on items obtained during gameplay thanks to a new tracking system.


Dialogue Sound Effects
Added subtle sound effects to dialogues to boost immersion and make conversations feel alive.


Enhanced Visual FX & Cues
New visual effects and additional feedback cues have been added across the game to improve clarity and player experience.


Minor bug fixes and level design changes.

See you in the rift!

notes.title: Community Feedback Patch – Update Now Live!
notes.notes:
This update is all about listening to you, the players. Thanks to your detailed feedback, we’ve implemented key fixes and improvements that make Absym smoother, clearer, and more enjoyable.  

🔸 = community report/suggestion.

Here’s what’s changed:Dialogue & Story Flow
🔸 The game now prevents you from interruptions like losing health or dying mid-conversation when dialogue is initiated.

🔸 Fixed an issue where interacting with journals near chests could cause a hard-lock during dialogues. 

Menu & Save Options
🔸 Pause menu now includes the option to return to the Main Menu (instead of only quitting to desktop).

🔸 Added "New Game" and "Continue" buttons for easier save management, no more manual wiping required for demo testing. 
Controls & UI Improvements
🔸 The Absym Shard inventory can now be closed with the same key used to open it, for more intuitive navigation.

🔸 Improved key/button icons: less pixelated, better color coding, and clearer readability for future localization.

🔸 Resource gain notifications (Absym Dust, Combat Knowledge, seeds, etc.) now appear on the left side of the screen, below the Absym Dust counter for improved visibility.

Tutorial Overhaul
Tutorials have been reworked for greater clarity with redesigned UI and the addition of tutorial videos, making it easier than ever to learn core mechanics and systems.


Visual & Gameplay Fixes
🔸 Updated the Stimpack icon for clarity: now more distinct from weapons, with improved color coding (red solution, warmer tones).

🔸 Charged shots can now break destructible objects like barrels and crates.

🔸 Charged shots now correctly damage Rift crystals.

🔸 Projectiles that hit non-destructible surfaces now display a vFX impact effect instead of disappearing instantly.

Adjustments to level design for smoother progression and navigation.

Bug Fixes & Miscellaneous
Additional minor bug fixes and quality-of-life improvements across the game.


Your feedback shapes Absym.
Join our Discord. Keep sharing your thoughts, and we’ll keep refining the world together.    


See you in the rift!

notes.title: Signals & Pathways – Level Navigation Update Now Live!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45338475/13bbb33f843d232a4b9b28630ff578abb19123d1.png"]

notes.title: Faces & Fates – Narrative & UI Update Now Live!
notes.notes:
This update dives deep into the soul of Absym, revamping how you interact with the world and the characters within it. From polished UI to pivotal choices, everything just got a bit more personal.
UI Revamps:
Boon Interface Overhaul

The Boon UI has been fully reworked for clarity, style, and usability. Choosing your powers should feel just as good as using them.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45338475/d9f58bc9edd3bea7d38ab5fc9fb4122b6a4841ab.png"]

Dialogue UI Rework

Conversations are now more expressive than ever. A fresh dialogue system brings character sprites into the scene, letting you see who you're talking to and feel their presence.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45338475/49ef365d9c41bd2f00afa048454ab8d1746787ab.png"]
New Story Event:
A brand-new narrative event has been added, thrusting the player into a high-stakes situation where choices matter. Your decisions will shape more than outcomes: they’ll define loyalties, risks, and your place in the world of Absym.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45338475/971c0b30ca83c9906a8616c4586fd7614c7b5757.png"]
Bug Fixes & Miscellaneous:
Various bug fixes and minor corrections across the game to ensure a smoother and more polished experience.
Every choice has a face. Every face has a story. Will you choose wisely?Update now and step into the most human chapter of Absym yet.

See you there, Rifters!

notes.title: Fire at Will – Combat Update Now Live!
notes.notes:
Lock, load, and move like never before. This update brings a major overhaul to ranged combat, giving you more speed, control, and tactical depth on the battlefield. 

Here's what's new:
Reworked Shooting Mechanics

Shooting is now faster and snappier, allowing for more responsive and satisfying gunplay.

Move While Shooting

Mobility is key, you're no longer rooted in place while firing. Dash, move, and reposition without interrupting your attack.

Updated Projectile FX

Every shot now feels (and looks) better. All projectile visual effects have been updated for a cleaner, more impactful experience.


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45338475/e33a16f8471aa27f59f1e91573a702e16d4513a5.png"]

Rifter Sidearm Overheat

The Rifter’s pistol now features an overheat mechanic. Firing too rapidly will cause it to overheat, temporarily disabling the weapon until it cools down. You can also upgrade your overheat bar at checkpoints, so don't panic!

Adapt, react, and fire at will. The battlefield just got a whole lot more dynamic!

notes.title: 📦 Boxes are Breakable – Patch update Now Live!
notes.notes:
Is this a JoJo Reference?


A brand new update has landed in Absym, and it’s time to smash expectations, literally. Get ready for environmental interactivity, story expansion, and visual upgrades across the board. Here’s what’s new in this patch:

✨ New Content

Breakable Boxes & Barrels
The world just got a bit more destructible. Discover hidden items, secrets, or simply let off some steam boxes and barrels across Absym can now be broken!

New Expedition Event
A new events plays out when you reach the central hub of the village.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45338475/e71ea4f4658bb7f2767b3a7142716f780adfa2d6.png

🏕 Visual & World Updates

Base Camp Redesign
Your home away from chaos just got a makeover. The base camp has been visually overhauled for a more immersive, lived-in atmosphere.

Water Visuals Rework
The look and feel of water has been completely refreshed, bringing a more dynamic, atmospheric, and visually polished experience to it.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45338475/fe343afb06676c5e571146b67a2b1ccc3aebca40.png

Tilt-Shift Effect Added
A subtle tilt-shift effect has been introduced to enhance depth perception and cinematic feel. The world of Absym now feels more alive and more like a living diorama.

🛠 Gameplay & Design Improvements

Level Design Tweaks
Continued refinement of level layout to enhance pacing, exploration, and combat flow.
